room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on all other expenses (except medicines) if room exceeds limit

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay on every admissible claim

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); Modern/listed procedures (robotic surgery, HIFU, etc.): up to 50% of SI

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, etc.; 48-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; max 50%

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (383 listed in Annexure C)

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses cover in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; ambulance equipment listed as non-payable item

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, consumables listed in Annexure A List I as non-payable items

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only (Section 10.7)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims not contestable except for fraud; applies to original SI; fresh 60-month period for enhanced SI

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting/migration

portability.note: Apply at least 45 days before renewal; continuity credits transferred

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary/OPD treatment, maternity, sterility/IVF, refractive error <7.5D, overseas treatment, war, nuclear/bio/chemical, substance abuse
